fidelity: F2a — Point Reactor Kinetics with Flowing-Fuel Precursor Drift + Lumped Thermal
source: Haubenreich & Engel (1970) Nucl. Appl. Technol. 8(2):118-136 (MSRE); Duderstadt & Hamilton (1976) Nuclear Reactor Analysis, Wiley; Keepin (1965) Physics of Nuclear Kinetics; MacPherson (1985) Nucl. Sci. Eng. 90:374-380.

unit.name: Generic 1 GWth Fluoride MSR (MSRE/MSBR-class) — Point Kinetics

P0_w.note: Rated thermal power (1000 MWth MSBR reference)

Lambda_s.note: Prompt neutron generation time (thermal MSR, graphite-moderated ~0.4 ms; Duderstadt 1976)

beta.note: Total static delayed-neutron fraction for U-235 (Keepin 1965)

tau_core_s.note: Fuel-salt transit time through the core region (MSRE-class)

tau_loop_s.note: Fuel-salt transit time through external loop (heat exchanger + piping); precursors decay/return here. MSRE total loop ~25 s (Haubenreich & Engel 1970)

alpha_fuel_pcm_per_K.note: Fuel-salt temperature/density reactivity coefficient; strongly negative (Doppler + thermal expansion of liquid fuel). MSRE ~ -3 to -5 pcm/K (Haubenreich & Engel 1970)

alpha_graphite_pcm_per_K.note: Graphite-moderator temperature reactivity coefficient (negative for MSRE-class)

M_fuel_kg.note: Mass of fuel salt resident in core thermal lump

cp_fuel_J_per_kgK.note: Fuel-salt (FLiBe-class) specific heat (Williams et al. 2006, ORNL/TM-2006/12)

M_loop_kg.note: Mass of fuel salt + structure in external loop thermal lump

hA_core_loop_W_per_K.note: Effective core->loop convective heat transfer coefficient * area

T_core0_K.note: Core fuel-salt temperature at rated power (~727 degC); ALSO the feedback reference T. Set to the thermal steady state P0=hA_cl*(Tc-Tl)=hA_ls*(Tl-Tsink) so rho_ext=0 is a true fixed point.

T_loop0_K.note: Loop fuel-salt temperature at rated power (660 degC); thermal steady state for P0.
